verses.gurmukhi: ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆ ਜਤ ਸਤ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਨ ਜਾਤੀ।
verses.translit_en: jatee satee sa(n)tokheeaa jat sat jugat sa(n)tokh na jaatee|

en.bdb: So called celibates, virtuous and contented ones have also not understood contentment, the actual technique of celibacy and other virtues.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਧ ਨਾਥੁ ਬਹੁ ਪੰਥ ਕਰਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਰਨਿ ਕਰਮਾਤੀ।
verses.translit_en: sidh naath bahu pa(n)th kar haumai vich karan karamaatee|

en.bdb: The siddhas and naths controlled by ego and divided into many sects roam hither and thither showing miraculous feats.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਨ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਖਹਿ ਖਹਿ ਮਰਦੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭਰਾਤੀ।
verses.translit_en: chaar varan sa(n)saar vich kheh kheh maradhe bharam bharaatee|

en.bdb: All the four varnas in the world going astray in delusions are clashing with one another.

verses.gurmukhi: ਛਿਅ ਦਰਸਨ ਹੋਇ ਵਰਤਿਆ ਬਾਰਹ ਵਾਟ ਉਚਾਟ ਜਮਾਤੀ।
verses.translit_en: chhia dharasan hoi varatiaa baareh vaaT uchaaT jamaatee|

en.bdb: Under the aegis of the six Shastras, yogis have adopted twelve ways and becoming indifferent to the world have gone away from its responsibilities.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਰਨ ਅਵਰਨ ਹੋਇ ਰੰਗ ਸੁਰੰਗ ਤੰਬੋਲ ਸੁਵਾਤੀ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh varan avaran hoi ra(n)g sura(n)g ta(n)bol suvaatee|

en.bdb: Gurmukh, who is beyond varnas and its further denominations, is like the betel leaf, which out of various colours adopts one steadfast colour (red) of all the virtues.

verses.gurmukhi: ਛਿਅ ਰੁਤਿ ਬਾਰਹ ਮਾਹ ਵਿਚਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸੁਝ ਸੁਝਾਤੀ।
verses.translit_en: chhia rut baareh maeh vich gurmukh dharasan sujh sujhaatee|

en.bdb: In the six seasons and twelve months as and when the gurmukh is visualized, he enlightens all like the sun of knowledge.
The delightful fruit for gurmukhs is his love for the Lord.
